body: buildFilingDateIndex renamed to buildFilingIndexes, now returns both dates AND forms maps keyed by filing identity. 4th 8-K detection path: filingForms[doc.Identity] == '8-K'. Resolves 880/1104 legacy docs that had form='' source_type='press_release' due to processor bug (EDGAR URLs don't contain form name so the URL check caught 0). 224 remaining unmatched docs may lack filing_discovered events or be genuinely non-8-K.
title: INTAKE entity-graph 8-K detection — 880 legacy docs now recoverable via filing form index
